domains.name: morphology
domains.definition: Body, limb, ear and skull measurements of an adult or a specimen.

domains.name: reproduction
domains.definition: Litter, gestation, weaning and maturity measurements.

domains.name: life_habit
domains.definition: Activity, movement, social behaviour, where the animal lives, and where the species occurs.

domains.name: home_range
domains.definition: Area used by an individual or a group.

domains.name: density
domains.definition: Number of individuals per unit area.

traits.name: Body mass
traits.definition: Mass of the whole body of an animal.

traits.name: Head-body length
traits.definition: Length from the tip of the nose to the base of the tail, not including the tail.

traits.name: Total length
traits.definition: Length from the tip of the nose to the tip of the tail, including the tail.

traits.name: Body length
traits.definition: Length of the body, reported without stating whether the tail is included.

traits.name: Tail length
traits.definition: Distance along the longest axis of the tail, from its base to the tip.

traits.name: Hind foot length
traits.definition: Length of the hind foot from the heel to the tip of the longest toe, not including the claw.

traits.name: Hind foot length with claw
traits.definition: Length of the hind foot from the heel to the tip of the longest claw.

traits.name: Ear length
traits.definition: Length of the external ear from the notch at its base to the tip, not including hairs.

traits.name: Forearm length
traits.definition: Length of the forearm from the elbow to the wrist.

traits.name: Tragus length
traits.definition: Length of the tragus from its base to its tip.

traits.name: Head length
traits.definition: Distance along the longest axis of the head, from the tip of the snout to the back of the head.

traits.name: Neck circumference
traits.definition: Distance around the neck.

traits.name: Tibia length
traits.definition: Length of the tibia along its longest axis.

traits.name: Brain mass
traits.definition: Mass of the brain.

traits.name: Neonate body mass
traits.definition: Body mass of a newborn animal at or shortly after birth.

traits.name: Weaning body mass
traits.definition: Body mass of a young animal at weaning.

traits.name: Greatest skull length
traits.definition: Greatest length of the skull from the front of the incisors to the most posterior point of the skull, including the incisors.

traits.name: Greatest skull length excluding incisors
traits.definition: Greatest length of the skull from the front of the premaxillae, not counting the incisors, to the most posterior point of the skull.

traits.name: Skull length
traits.definition: Length of the skull, reported without stating the measurement points or whether the incisors are included.

traits.name: Condylobasal length
traits.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the premaxillae to the back of the occipital condyles.

traits.name: Condylo-incisive length
traits.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the upper incisors to the back of the occipital condyles.

traits.name: Condylocanine length
traits.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the upper canines to the back of the occipital condyles.

traits.name: Occipitonasal length
traits.definition: Length of the skull from the front of the nasals to the back of the occiput.

traits.name: Basal length
traits.definition: Length of the skull along the base from the front of the premaxillae to the front of the foramen magnum.

traits.name: Basal length, unspecified
traits.definition: Length of the skull called basal length, where the paper does not say which points were used.

traits.name: Zygomatic breadth
traits.definition: Greatest width of the skull across the zygomatic arches.

traits.name: Braincase breadth
traits.definition: Greatest width of the braincase, not including the mastoid or zygomatic structures.

traits.name: Braincase height
traits.definition: Height of the braincase from the base of the skull to its highest point.

traits.name: Mastoid breadth
traits.definition: Greatest width of the skull across the mastoid processes.

traits.name: Interorbital breadth
traits.definition: Least width of the skull between the orbits.

traits.name: Postorbital constriction
traits.definition: Least width of the skull behind the orbits.

traits.name: Palatal length
traits.definition: Length of the palate from the front of the premaxillae to the back of the hard palate.

traits.name: Palatal length, unspecified
traits.definition: Length of the palate, where the paper does not say whether the measurement starts at the premaxillae or at the incisors.

traits.name: Postpalatal length
traits.definition: Length from the back of the hard palate to the front of the foramen magnum.

traits.name: Nasal length
traits.definition: Greatest length of the nasal bones.

traits.name: Rostral length
traits.definition: Length of the rostrum from the front of the nasals to the front of the orbits.

traits.name: Rostral breadth
traits.definition: Least width of the rostrum across the maxillae, in front of the orbits.

traits.name: Maxillary toothrow length
traits.definition: Length of the upper tooth row from the front of the canine to the back of the last molar.

traits.name: Mandibular toothrow length
traits.definition: Length of the lower tooth row from the front of the canine to the back of the last molar.

traits.name: Mandible length
traits.definition: Length of the lower jaw from the front of the incisors to the back of the condyle.

traits.name: Coronoid process height
traits.definition: Height of the coronoid process of the mandible from its base to its tip.

traits.name: Upper diastema length
traits.definition: Length of the upper diastema, the gap between the upper incisors and the upper cheek teeth.

traits.name: Lower diastema length
traits.definition: Length of the lower diastema, the gap between the lower incisors and the lower cheek teeth.

traits.name: Maxillary breadth
traits.definition: Width of the skull across the maxillae, at the outer edges of the cheek teeth.

traits.name: Width across upper second molars
traits.definition: Greatest width across the outer edges of the upper second molars.

traits.name: Zygomatic plate breadth
traits.definition: Width of the zygomatic plate at its narrowest point.

traits.name: Width across upper canines
traits.definition: Greatest width across the outer edges of the upper canines.

traits.name: Postpalatal depth
traits.definition: Depth of the skull behind the hard palate, from the underside of the skull to the top of the braincase.

traits.name: Auditory bulla length
traits.definition: Greatest length of the auditory bulla.

traits.name: Litter size
traits.definition: Number of young born in one litter.

traits.name: Litters per year
traits.definition: Number of litters one female produces in a year.

traits.name: Gestation length
traits.definition: Time from conception to birth.

traits.name: Weaning age
traits.definition: Age at which a young animal stops nursing.

traits.name: Interbirth interval
traits.definition: Time between two successive births of the same female.

traits.name: Age at first reproduction, female
traits.definition: Age at which a female first gives birth.

traits.name: Age at sexual maturity, female
traits.definition: Age at which a female first becomes able to reproduce.

traits.name: Age at sexual maturity, male
traits.definition: Age at which a male first becomes able to reproduce.

traits.name: Maximum longevity
traits.definition: Greatest recorded age of an individual of the species.

traits.name: Activity cycle
traits.definition: Time of day when the animal is active: nocturnal, crepuscular, diurnal, nocturnal/crepuscular, diurnal/crepuscular, or cathemeral (active at any time of day).

traits.name: Hibernation or torpor
traits.definition: Whether the animal hibernates, uses torpor, or does neither.

traits.name: Migratory status
traits.definition: Whether the animal migrates seasonally.

traits.name: Domestication status
traits.definition: Whether the animal is domestic or wild.

traits.name: Social group size
traits.definition: Number of individuals in one cohesive social group.

traits.name: Individual home range size
traits.definition: Area one individual uses during normal activity.

traits.name: Group home range size
traits.definition: Area one social group uses during normal activity.

traits.name: Population density
traits.definition: Number of individuals per unit area.

traits.name: Basal metabolic rate
traits.definition: Energy used per hour by a whole animal while resting, post-absorptive, and in its thermoneutral zone.

traits.name: Basal oxygen consumption
traits.definition: Volume of oxygen used per hour by a whole animal while resting, post-absorptive, and in its thermoneutral zone.

traits.name: Call peak frequency
traits.definition: Frequency with the most energy in a call.

traits.name: Call start frequency
traits.definition: Frequency at the start of a call.

traits.name: Call end frequency
traits.definition: Frequency at the end of a call.

traits.name: Call duration
traits.definition: Time from the start to the end of a call.

traits.name: Age at sexual maturity
traits.definition: Age at which an animal first becomes able to reproduce, when the paper does not give it by sex.

traits.name: Generation length
traits.definition: Average age of the parents of the current cohort of the species.

traits.name: Age at eye opening
traits.definition: Age at which a young animal first opens its eyes.

traits.name: Dispersal age
traits.definition: Age at which a young animal leaves its birth site to disperse.

traits.name: Neonate head-body length
traits.definition: Head-body length of a newborn animal at or shortly after birth.

traits.name: Weaning head-body length
traits.definition: Head-body length of a young animal at weaning.

traits.name: Teat number
traits.definition: Number of teats of an adult female.

traits.name: Dispersal distance
traits.definition: Distance from the birth site to the site where the animal settles after dispersing.

traits.name: Fossoriality
traits.definition: Whether the animal lives mainly underground.

traits.name: Foraging stratum
traits.definition: Vertical level where the animal mainly forages: on the ground, in trees (arboreal), in flight (aerial), or in water (aquatic).

traits.name: Terrestriality
traits.definition: Whether the animal lives on the ground or above the ground, in trees, on cliffs or in the air.

traits.name: Island endemicity
traits.definition: Whether the species is found only on islands.

traits.name: Habitat breadth
traits.definition: Number of habitat layers the species uses, out of above ground, aquatic, fossorial, and ground.

traits.name: Population group size
traits.definition: Number of individuals that spend most of a 24-hour cycle together, whether or not they form a lasting social group.
